actions.WHAT: Verify the Finding Stories LinkedIn account, approve the project-overview post, and publish it through the authorized account.
actions.WHY: The complete advisory post has the strongest ready path from professional discovery to an attributable enquiry.
actions.WHAT TO CAPTURE: Owned account URL, approval, public post URL, screenshot and publication time.
actions.HOW TO MARK COMPLETE: Set publish status to PUBLISHED only after recording the public post URL, screenshot, approval and publication time.

actions.WHAT: Export the Florence Search Console page report and review available organic/referral lead attribution; leave every unavailable metric null.
actions.WHY: Real query and conversion evidence is required before any content refresh decision.
actions.WHERE: Google Search Console Performance and URL Inspection for the exact canonical page
actions.WHAT TO CAPTURE: Export date/range, property, filters and privacy-safe lead report reference.
actions.HOW TO MARK COMPLETE: Set data_status to available only after importing the dated export; preserve null for every absent metric.

actions.WHAT: Select one known, consented and contextually relevant buyer; approve and manually send the matching WhatsApp buyer message.
actions.WHY: A relevant one-to-one share provides a short path to an advisor conversation without cold outreach.
actions.WHERE: Authorized advisor WhatsApp account and an existing consented conversation
actions.WHAT TO CAPTURE: Privacy-safe internal send record and attributed outcome when available.
actions.HOW TO MARK COMPLETE: Record a privacy-safe send outcome; do not mark a reply, lead or meeting without evidence.

actions.WHAT: Verify one existing professional relationship and approve the matching referral message; do not contact an unverified candidate.
actions.WHY: A legitimate relationship can qualify audience context before a project visit.
actions.WHERE: Internal relationship record; no external send
actions.WHAT TO CAPTURE: Privacy-safe relationship basis, approval and later send/result evidence.
actions.HOW TO MARK COMPLETE: Replace the null target in referral/outreach queue only after the relationship owner verifies it.

actions.WHAT: Verify one named, relevant editorial or directory target and record its current public eligibility or contact route without submitting.
actions.WHY: Existing authority records contain candidate categories rather than verified target evidence.
actions.WHAT TO CAPTURE: Target name, public domain, relevant current page, route and check date.
actions.HOW TO MARK COMPLETE: Set verification_status only; submission/live states remain unchanged until separate evidence exists.
